title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices (version 9.3.0, 08 series of amendments)
scope_summary: UN R48 approves a vehicle type with regard to the number and mode of installation of its lighting and light-signalling devices: which lamps, retro-reflectors and markings are fitted, and their position, visibility, colour, switching and tell-tales. It applies to motor vehicles of categories M and N and their trailers (category O); the devices themselves are component-approved under other Regulations (LSD/RID/RRD).
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories M, N, and to their trailers (category O) with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to_components: Main-beam (driving-beam) headlamp, incl. auxiliary main-beam lamp and adaptive main-beam
Dipped-beam (passing-beam) headlamp, incl. headlamp-levelling and automatic switching
Rear registration plate lamp (rear-registration plate illuminating device)
External status indicator (excluded from lamp definition)
Light sources, LED modules, LED substitute light sources and electronic light source control gear (as installed)
relation_to_other_regulations: Definitions apply to the Light-Signalling Devices (LSD, UN R148), Road Illumination Devices (RID, UN R149) and Retro-Reflective Devices (RRD, UN R150) Regulations, under which the devices are component-approved.
Standard (étalon) light sources refer to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and 128.
Service-door-lighting system of M2/M3 vehicles per UN R107 is not considered a lamp.
Direction-indicator lamps may also be used according to UN R97, R116, R162 or R163; external status indicator relates to VAS/AS/immobilizer of UN R97, R116, R162 or R163.
Retro-reflecting materials approved as Class D, E or F under UN R104 or [RRD] used for other purposes are not retro-reflectors.
Retro-reflective tyres according to UN R88 excluded from night-time retro-reflected colour definitions.
AFS control signals characterised according to Annex 14 to UN R149.
Vehicle categories as defined in R.E.3 (ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3).
Approval numbers currently start with 08 (08 series of amendments); transitional provisions for 07 series in 12.6.

defined_terms.label: Device
defined_terms.definition: An element or an assembly of elements used to perform one or more functions.

defined_terms.label: Lighting function
defined_terms.definition: Light emitted by a device to illuminate the road and objects in the direction of vehicle movement.

defined_terms.label: Light-signalling function
defined_terms.definition: Light emitted or reflected by a device to give other road users visual information on the presence, identification and/or change of movement of the vehicle.

defined_terms.label: Lamp
defined_terms.definition: A device designed to illuminate the road or emit a light signal to other road users, including rear registration plate lamps and retro-reflectors, but excluding light-emitting rear registration plates, R107 service-door lighting and external status indicators.

defined_terms.label: Change index
defined_terms.definition: Sequential number per lamp function in LSD/RID/RRD indicating how many times higher stringency requirements were introduced.

defined_terms.label: Manufacturer logo
defined_terms.definition: A graphic mark, emblem, word or combination used to promote public recognition of a vehicle manufacturer's brand name.

defined_terms.label: Vehicle type with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices
defined_terms.definition: Vehicles not differing in dimensions/external shape, number and positioning of devices, headlamp-levelling system and suspension system.

defined_terms.label: Operating tell-tale
defined_terms.definition: A visual or auditory signal indicating that a device has been switched ON and is operating correctly or not.

defined_terms.label: Closed-circuit tell-tale
defined_terms.definition: A visual signal indicating that a device has been switched ON, without indicating whether it operates correctly.

defined_terms.label: Movable components
defined_terms.definition: Body panels or other vehicle parts whose position can be changed by tilting, rotating or sliding without tools, excluding tiltable truck cabs.

defined_terms.label: Independent lamps
defined_terms.definition: Devices with separate apparent surfaces, separate light sources and separate lamp bodies.

defined_terms.label: Grouped lamps
defined_terms.definition: Devices with separate apparent surfaces and separate light sources but a common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Combined lamps
defined_terms.definition: Devices with separate apparent surfaces but a common light source and common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Reciprocally incorporated lamps
defined_terms.definition: Devices with separate light sources (or one source under different conditions), totally or partially common apparent surfaces and a common lamp body.

defined_terms.label: Single-function lamp
defined_terms.definition: A part of a device which performs a single lighting or light-signalling function.

defined_terms.label: Concealable lamp
defined_terms.definition: A lamp capable of being partly or completely hidden when not in use, e.g. by movable cover or displacement (retractable).

defined_terms.label: Optional lamp
defined_terms.definition: A lamp whose installation is left to the discretion of the manufacturer.

defined_terms.label: Matched pair
defined_terms.definition: Set of left and right lamps of the same function which, as a pair, complies with the photometric requirements.

defined_terms.label: Single lamp
defined_terms.definition: A device with one function and one apparent surface, or an assembly of two 'D' lamps, two separately approved retro-reflectors, or an interdependent 'Y' lamp system providing the same function.

defined_terms.label: Interdependent lamp system
defined_terms.definition: An assembly of two or three interdependent lamps (marked 'Y') providing the same function.

defined_terms.label: Lamps marked 'D'
defined_terms.definition: Independent lamps approved so they may be used independently or as an assembly of two considered a single lamp.

defined_terms.label: Additional lighting unit
defined_terms.definition: Part of a headlamp system providing bend lighting, independent from the principal passing-beam device.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflective device
defined_terms.definition: An assembly ready for use comprising one or more retro-reflective optical units, divided into Classes IA/IB, IIIA/IIIB and IVA.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflective marking material
defined_terms.definition: A surface or device from which a relatively large portion of incident radiation is retro-reflected.

defined_terms.label: Rear marking plate
defined_terms.definition: A plate faced with retro-reflective and fluorescent material to increase visibility of heavy and long vehicles.

defined_terms.label: Slow moving vehicle (SMV) rear marking plate
defined_terms.definition: A triangular plate with truncated corners faced with retro-reflective and fluorescent material in a characteristic pattern.

defined_terms.label: Driving-beam (main-beam) headlamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp used to illuminate the road over a long distance ahead of the vehicle.

defined_terms.label: Auxiliary driving-beam lamp
defined_terms.definition: A driving-beam approved as a separate lamp supplementing a driving-beam of another class.

defined_terms.label: Passing-beam (dipped-beam) headlamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp used to illuminate the road ahead without undue dazzle or discomfort to oncoming drivers and other road users.

defined_terms.label: Principal passing-beam
defined_terms.definition: The dipped-beam produced without contribution of IR emitter and/or additional bend-lighting light sources.

defined_terms.label: Direction-indicator lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp used to indicate that the driver intends to change direction to the right or left.

defined_terms.label: Stop lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp indicating to road users behind that the vehicle's longitudinal movement is intentionally retarded.

defined_terms.label: Rear-registration plate illuminating device
defined_terms.definition: Device used to illuminate the space reserved for the rear registration plate, possibly of several optical components.

defined_terms.label: Front position lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp indicating the presence and width of the vehicle viewed from the front.

defined_terms.label: Rear position lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp indicating the presence and width of the vehicle viewed from the rear.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Device indicating vehicle presence by reflecting light from a source not connected to the vehicle, excluding number plates, ADR signals, national plates and Class D/E/F materials used for other purposes.

defined_terms.label: Conspicuity marking
defined_terms.definition: Retro-reflective device increasing vehicle conspicuity from the side or rear (trailers also front).

defined_terms.label: Contour marking
defined_terms.definition: Conspicuity marking indicating length, width and height of the vehicle (full or partial).

defined_terms.label: Line marking
defined_terms.definition: Conspicuity marking indicating the horizontal dimensions of a vehicle by a continuous line.

defined_terms.label: Front fog lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp improving road illumination ahead in fog or similar reduced visibility.

defined_terms.label: Rear fog lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp making the vehicle more easily visible from the rear in dense fog.

defined_terms.label: Reversing lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp illuminating the road to the rear and warning that the vehicle is reversing or about to reverse.

defined_terms.label: Parking lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp drawing attention to a stationary vehicle in a built-up area, replacing front and rear position lamps.

defined_terms.label: End-outline marker lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp near the extreme outer edge and top of the vehicle indicating overall width, complementing position lamps.

defined_terms.label: Side marker lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp indicating the presence of the vehicle viewed from the side.

defined_terms.label: Daytime running lamp
defined_terms.definition: Forward-facing lamp making the vehicle more easily visible when driving during daytime.

defined_terms.label: Cornering lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp providing supplementary illumination near the forward corner of the vehicle on the side towards which it turns.

defined_terms.label: Exterior courtesy lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp providing supplementary illumination to assist the user to approach/depart, enter/exit or load/unload the vehicle.

defined_terms.label: Manoeuvring lamp
defined_terms.definition: Lamp providing supplementary illumination to the side and/or rear to assist slow manoeuvres.

defined_terms.label: External status indicator
defined_terms.definition: Optical signal outside the vehicle indicating status of VAS, AS or immobilizer (R97/116/162/163) when parked.

defined_terms.label: Reversing projector
defined_terms.definition: A device used to provide reversing projection.

defined_terms.label: Hazard warning signal
defined_terms.definition: Simultaneous operation of all direction-indicator lamps to show the vehicle temporarily constitutes a special danger.

defined_terms.label: Emergency stop signal
defined_terms.definition: Signal to rear road users that a high retardation force has been applied relative to road conditions.

defined_terms.label: Rear-end collision alert signal (RECAS)
defined_terms.definition: Automatic signal from leading to following vehicle warning it must take emergency action to avoid a collision.

defined_terms.label: Answer-back signal
defined_terms.definition: Signal assisting the user to identify and find the car in park condition.

defined_terms.label: Bend lighting
defined_terms.definition: A lighting function providing enhanced illumination in bends.

defined_terms.label: Adaptive front lighting system (AFS)
defined_terms.definition: Lighting device providing beams with differing characteristics for automatic adaptation of the dipped beam and, if applicable, main beam.

defined_terms.label: Lighting unit
defined_terms.definition: Light-emitting component providing or contributing to one or more AFS front lighting functions.

defined_terms.label: Installation unit
defined_terms.definition: An indivisible housing (lamp body) containing one or more lighting units.

defined_terms.label: System control
defined_terms.definition: Part(s) of the AFS receiving control signals from the vehicle and automatically controlling the lighting units.

defined_terms.label: Adaptive main-beam
defined_terms.definition: AFS main-beam adapting its pattern to oncoming and preceding vehicles to avoid glare.

defined_terms.label: Class of passing beam (C, V, E, W)
defined_terms.definition: Designation of passing beam by particular provisions: C basic, V lit areas, E motorways, W adverse/wet conditions.

defined_terms.label: Bending mode
defined_terms.definition: Mode of a front-lighting function with laterally moved/modified illumination for bends, Category 1 (kink moves) or Category 2 (kink does not move).

defined_terms.label: Supply and operating device
defined_terms.definition: Component(s) providing power to parts of the system, including voltage controls such as electronic light source control gears.

defined_terms.label: Traffic-change function
defined_terms.definition: Front-lighting function or mode to avoid glare when a vehicle designed for one traffic direction is used in opposite-traffic countries.

defined_terms.label: Substitute function
defined_terms.definition: Front-lighting/signalling function or mode intended to replace a front-lighting function in case of failure.

defined_terms.label: Sequential activation
defined_terms.definition: Wiring where individual light sources of a lamp switch ON in a predetermined sequence.

defined_terms.label: Driver Assistance Projection
defined_terms.definition: A modification of the light distribution for driver assistance purposes.

defined_terms.label: Reversing projection
defined_terms.definition: Light signal projected on the ground by reversing projectors to enhance recognition of reversing indication.

defined_terms.label: Lens
defined_terms.definition: Outermost component of the lamp transmitting light through the illuminating surface.

defined_terms.label: Light source
defined_terms.definition: One or more elements for visible radiation with a base for mechanical and electrical connection.

defined_terms.label: Light source module
defined_terms.definition: Device-specific optical part containing one or more non-replaceable light sources and optionally holders for replaceable ones.

defined_terms.label: LED light source
defined_terms.definition: Light source whose only visible radiation element is one or more solid state junctions producing electroluminescence.

defined_terms.label: LED substitute light source
defined_terms.definition: LED light source of a category having a counterpart category using another light generating technology.

defined_terms.label: LED module
defined_terms.definition: A light source module containing only LEDs as light sources.

defined_terms.label: Electronic light source control gear
defined_terms.definition: Components between supply and light source controlling voltage and/or current of the light source.

defined_terms.label: Ballast
defined_terms.definition: Components controlling the current of a gas-discharge light source.

defined_terms.label: Variable intensity control
defined_terms.definition: Device automatically controlling rear light-signalling devices with variable intensities, part of lamp, vehicle or split.

applicability_hints: R48 approves only the vehicle installation; the lamp or retro-reflector itself needs component approval under R148 (LSD), R149 (RID) or R150 (RRD), but any exterior lamp product sold for M/N/O vehicles must be installable in compliance with R48.
Rear registration plate lamps and retro-reflectors count as lamps; light-emitting rear registration plates, R107 service-door lighting and external status indicators do not.
Any change to headlamp-levelling system or suspension can create a new vehicle type and affect dipped-beam inclination requirements (Annex 5, 6, 8).
Body panels, tailgates, doors or other movable components carrying lamps fall under geometric visibility/position rules for movable components.
Conspicuity tapes, rear marking plates and SMV plates are covered as retro-reflective marking; Class D/E/F materials used for other national purposes are excluded.

Electronic control units for lamps (control gear, ballasts, variable intensity control, AFS system control, automatic main-beam/dipped-beam switching sensors and logic) are covered via switching and electrical connection requirements.
Vehicle alarm/immobilizer status lights and use of direction indicators for alarm signalling link R48 to R97/R116/R162/R163.
Ground projections (driver assistance projection, reversing projection) and logos in lamps are regulated by R48.
Lamps with LED substitute light sources may only be installed if the manufacturer's statement permits.
Interior lighting is not covered except tell-tales for exterior lighting functions.
